ghi_chu.ly_do: London in 1666 had no such spire. Old St Paul's had lost its spire in 1561. A Victorian-style Gothic spire on the skyline is anachronistic.

ghi_chu.ly_do: This is the later justaucorps and buckle-shoe fashion of the 1680s and after. In 1666 men wore shorter doublet-style coats, petticoat breeches, and shoes tied with ribbon.

ghi_chu.ly_do: Sash windows were not introduced in England until about the 1670s. A great house in 1666 would more likely have leaded or stone-mullioned casements.
